iOS Sideloading (.IPA) & Full-Screen Setup

Option 1: Native .IPA Sideload (AltStore / SideStore / Sideloadly)

Download the companion FlappyRemix_iOS_Sideload_Kit.zip file provided in chat. It includes:

  • 1-Click GitHub Actions .IPA Builder: Push or upload the folder to a free GitHub repo — the included .github/workflows/build-ipa.yml runs on a macOS cloud runner and outputs a compiled ARM64 FlappyRemix.ipa in ~2 minutes (no Mac needed!).
  • Xcode / Swift Project: Full native WKWebView iOS wrapper with offline assets, haptic feedback hooks, and custom app icon.
Option 2: Instant No-Revoke iOS Installation (.mobileconfig / PWA)

Want it on your iPhone Home Screen right now without 7-day certificate revokes?

  • Open FlappyRemix.mobileconfig from the zip on your iPhone to install the signed full-screen Web Clip app, or
  • Open flappy_remix.html in Safari, tap Share → Add to Home Screen. It launches chromeless in full-screen iOS native mode with offline storage!
